name: Smog
description: Air pollution from anything that burns.

pages.title: Smog
pages.text:
**Smog** is Create: Smog's air pollution, tracked per chunk. Anything that burns adds some; it spreads to nearby chunks and fades slowly, faster in rain.\
\
Heavy smog gives Nausea, Toxic adds Poison and Weakness, and it harms crops. Flues and air scrubbers fix it. An Aerometer reads it.
